items.heading: Fungee and Pepperpot
details: Key ingredients: cornmeal, okra, spinach, salted meat, pumpkin
Cook cornmeal with okra, stirring constantly into a firm dough (fungee).
Simmer salted meat with spinach, pumpkin and seasonings for the pepperpot stew.
Cook until the stew thickens and the meat is tender.
Mold the fungee and serve alongside a generous ladle of pepperpot.

items.heading: Saltfish and Antiguan Black Pineapple
details: Key ingredients: salted codfish, onions, tomatoes, black pineapple
Soak and boil salted codfish to remove excess salt, then flake it.
Saute onions, tomatoes and peppers until soft.
Toss the flaked fish through the sauteed vegetables.
Serve with slices of sweet local black pineapple on the side.
